name: Self Made
how: Win a regatta without buying anyone.

name: The Whole Club
how: Collect every [shop rower](wiki/characters/): buy them and finish the regatta.
Beat the first bonus song. It appears on the regatta screen once you've won all four [regattas](wiki/events/).
Beat the second bonus song. Beating the first one unlocks it.
Beat the third bonus song. Beating the second one unlocks it.
Unlock every other achievement, then click its card to claim it. Claiming it plays a one-off cutscene and puts the Olympus Trophy in the trophy cabinet on the home screen.

name: That's a Big Repair
how: Get caught in the lightning storm. Storms only hit rainy races at the [Head of the Charles](wiki/events/head-of-the-charles/).

name: Big Leagues
how: Turn on Expert mode in Options.

name: Infinite Possibilities
how: Beat any custom song in Free Play. Make one with the [Song Converter](SongConverter.html).
